page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The server provisions 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB of memory per core on x86_64 architecture. Baseline network connectivity is rated at 32 Gbps. The instance contains no integrated local SSD storage and no discrete GPU accelerators.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU hardware ratio provides high compute core density, making it cost-efficient for parallel CPU processing where large memory allocations are unnecessary. Because local ephemeral storage is absent, all persistent file system requirements must be addressed through network-attached block storage. This architecture optimizes compute hardware costs by eliminating unneeded local storage controllers and high-capacity RAM arrays.

The ecs.c7a.32xlarge server is suited for CPU-bound enterprise workloads, including large-scale software compilation, high-performance batch processing, electronic design automation, scientific simulations, and financial risk modeling.
